description_en: Queries a list of custom alert rules
description_zh: 获取或搜索自定义监控规则列表
name: ListReminds

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Valid values: 1 to 30. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 分页的页数。默认值为1，最小值为1，最大值为30
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示的条数，默认为10条，最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to create the custom alert rules
parameters.name: founder

parameters.help_en: The ID of the node to which the custom alert rules are applied. You can use the ID to search for the custom alert rules that are applied to the node
parameters.help_zh: 规则的对象，任务节点ID。您可以根据任务节点ID搜索覆盖该任务节点的自定义监控规则
parameters.name: node_id

parameters.help_en: The conditions that trigger an alert for the node. Valid values: FINISHED, UNFINISHED, ERROR, CYCLE_UNFINISHED, and TIMEOUT. The value FINISHED indicates that the node finishes running. The value UNFINISHED indicates that the node is still running at the specified point in time. The value ERROR indicates that an error occurs when the node is running. The value CYCLE_UNFINISHED indicates that the node does not finish running in the specified scheduling cycle. The value TIMEOUT indicates that the node times out. You can specify multiple conditions for a custom alert rule. If you specify multiple condition, separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 触发条件，包括FINISHED（完成）、UNFINISHED（未完成）、ERROR（出错）、CYCLE_UNFINISHED（周期未完成）和TIMEOUT（运行超时）。多个触发条件之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: remind_types

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that is used to receive alert notifications
parameters.name: alert_target

parameters.help_en: The keyword in a rule name that is used to search for the rule. Fuzzy search is supported
parameters.name: search_text

Data.description_zh: 返回的自定义监控规则列表

PageNumber.description_en: The page number of the returned page

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

Reminds.description_en: The list of custom alert rules

AlertMethods.description_en: The notification method. Valid values: MAIL, SMS, and PHONE. The value MAIL indicates that the notification is sent by email. Only DataWorks Professional Edition and more advanced editions support the PHONE notification method
AlertMethods.description_zh: 报警的方式，包括MAIL（邮件）、SMS（短信）和PHONE（电话，仅DataWorks专业版及以上版本支持）

items.description_en: The notification method. Valid values: MAIL, SMS, and PHONE. The value MAIL indicates that the notification is sent by email. Only DataWorks Professional Edition and more advanced editions support the PHONE notification method
items.description_zh: 报警的方式，包括MAIL（邮件）、SMS（短信）和PHONE（电话，仅DataWorks专业版及以上版本支持）

AlertTargets.description_en: The IDs of the Alibaba Cloud accounts used by alert recipients
AlertTargets.description_zh: 报警接收人的阿里云UID列表

items.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the alert recipient
items.description_zh: 报警接收人的阿里云UID列表

AlertUnit.description_en: The alert recipient. Valid values: OWNER and OTHER. The value OWNER indicates the node owner. The value OTHER indicates a specified user
AlertUnit.description_zh: 报警接收对象的粒度，包括OWNER（任务责任人）和OTHER（指定的人）

BaselineIds.description_en: The IDs of the baselines to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is BASELINE
BaselineIds.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为BASELINE（基线）时，监控的基线ID列表

items.description_en: The ID of the baseline to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is BASELINE
items.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为BASELINE（基线）时，监控的基线ID列表

BizProcessIds.description_en: The IDs of the workflows to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is BIZPROCESS
BizProcessIds.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为BIZPROCESS（业务流程）时，监控的基线ID列表

items.description_en: The ID of the workflow to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is BIZPROCESS
items.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为BIZPROCESS（业务流程）时，监控的基线ID列表

DndEnd.description_en: The end time of the quiet hours. The time is in the hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: [0,23]. Valid values of mm: [0,59]
DndEnd.description_zh: 免打扰截止时间，格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,23]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]

DndStart.description_en: The start time of the quiet hours. The time is in the hh:mm format. Valid values of hh: [0,23]. Valid values of mm: [0,59]
DndStart.description_zh: 免打扰起始时间，格式为hh:mm。hh的取值范围为[0,23]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]

Founder.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account used by the rule creator

NodeIds.description_en: The IDs of the nodes to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is NODE
NodeIds.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为NODE（任务节点）时，监控的节点ID列表

items.description_en: The ID of the node to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is NODE
items.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为NODE（任务节点）时，监控的节点ID列表

ProjectIds.description_en: The IDs of the workspaces to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is PROJECT
ProjectIds.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为PROJECT（工作空间）时，监控的节点ID列表

items.description_en: The ID of the workspace to which the custom alert rule is applied. This parameter is returned if the value of the RemindUnit parameter is PROJECT
items.description_zh: 当RemindUnit（对象类型）为PROJECT（工作空间）时，监控的节点ID列表

RemindName.description_en: The name of the custom alert rule
RemindName.description_zh: 自定义监控规则的名称

RemindType.description_en: The condition that triggers an alert. Valid values: FINISHED, UNFINISHED, ERROR, CYCLE_UNFINISHED, and TIMEOUT
RemindType.description_zh: 触发条件，包括FINISHED（完成）、UNFINISHED（未完成）、ERROR（出错）、CYCLE_UNFINISHED（周期未完成）和TIMEOUT（运行超时）

RemindUnit.description_en: The type of the object to which the custom alert rule is applied. Valid values: NODE, BASELINE, PROJECT, and BIZPROCESS. The value NODE indicates a node. The value BASELINE indicates a baseline. The value PROJECT indicates a workspace. The value BIZPROCESS indicates a workflow
RemindUnit.description_zh: 对象的类型，包括NODE（任务节点）、BASELINE（基线）、PROJECT（工作空间）和BIZPROCESS（业务流程）

Useflag.description_en: Indicates whether the custom alert rule is enabled. Valid values: true and false
Useflag.description_zh: 规则是否开启，包括true（开启）和false（关闭）

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of custom alert rules returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 自定义监控规则的总数

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request. You can use the ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
